title: Bodega bonanza!
text: We loved this tour. Plenty of food, drinks, and culture. Ivan was an excellent guide. We enjoyed every minute of exploring a new side of Barcelona.
author: JeromeBK

title: Wonderful introduction to Barcelona
text: Pam was a wonderful guide. She shared knowledge of the history and culture of Barcelona and helped us understand how to eat out in Spain. We keep talking about how the tour set us up to get the most out of our trip - from visiting the markets to enjoying a glass of Vermut with a little salty snack on the side.
author: albertatraveller2022

title: A must do tour
text: What a great experience! Our guide, Guillaume, was fabulous! Informative and charismatic! He told us history and culinary experiences, We walked and talked our way around Sant Antoni market and Eixample learning the ways of the city. All of this with great cava, vermut, wine and delicious food to sample.
author: E4600UFkatej

title: Fun times
text: Fun and educational tour with a small group.  Lots of walking and eating.  Good times.  Our guide was really fantastic - had interesting convos with him about what it’s like to live in BCN.  Will check out other tours in other cities!
author: Culture67085080410

title: A must do
text: This is a must do experience if you are in Barcelona! It was a great experience to be able to try bodegas and bars which we would never have thought to go to. We also had the opportunity to try things we either wouldn’t normally order or wouldn’t know to order. I will definitely be booking more food tours with culinary backstreets when I travel in the future.
author: Isabella_F

title: A great afternoon
text: An interesting evening spent in a less-touristy part of Barcelona.
author: teresasV4

title: Lovely taste of local culture
text: We really enjoyed the Culinary Backstreets Bodega tour in Raval, the St. Antoni Market and surrounding areas. Can’t recommend it enough. We learned so much and experienced so much of the local culture of Barcelona all while eating and drinking many examples of local tapas and beverages including pan con tomate, Gildas,  jamón Ibéricos, berberechos, and cod fritters. Ivan was a fantastic guide who was so knowledgeable and friendly who patiently explained the history of everywhere we went while getting to know us too. Take this tour!
author: FrequentFlier625948

title: Another wonderful Culinary Backstreets experience
text: We had a delightful tour with Ivan. We tasted delightful food and beverages, and learned so much about the bodega culture in Barcelona. We always have great experiences with Culinary Backstreets, and it was true again this time.
author: lynnej177

title: Great tour of the wine and food of Barcelona
text: Really excellent tour with Lynda.  A good mixture of history of Barcelona, visiting one of the big markets (am now an expert on the different jamon iberico, very useful) and of course numerous bodegas to try different drinks and food.  I really appreciated that we had a range of diffrent drinks - cava, rancio, vermut and several different wines.  And we tried Horchata de chufa (tiger nut milk, delicious) and ended with super churros and chocolate.
author: Intrepid75a

title: Bodega fun
text: This was a perfect introduction to the food of northern Spain. Pam explained the history of bodegas and choice a wide array of food and wine for us to enjoy. She was very knowledgeable about the ingredients and source. It was a perfect way to spend our first night in Barcelona.
author: Darlene_W
